messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11. [constraint; valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune's standup decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- On 2025-09-08, the Team Boreal on-call swapped and Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-07-10, the Team Cinder on-call swapped and Yuki carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-07-10 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-10]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- As of 2025-10-27, Yuki is the primary on-call for Team Cinder, having taken over from Diego. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, Diego is the primary on-call for Team Cinder, having taken over from Yuki. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-10, Yuki is the primary on-call for Team Cinder, carrying the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-07-10 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-10]
    earlier: As of the 2025-05-19 rotation day, Diego is the primary on-call for Team Cinder, having received the pager from Yuki. [valid 2025-05-19 to 2025-07-10; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-09, Yuki is the primary on-call for Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-09 to 2025-05-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-09]
- The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- On the 2026-02-04 rotation day, Team Dune's on-call swapped and Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
- On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-06]
- As of the 2025-06-05 rotation day, Marcus is the primary on-call for Team Boreal, and Lena is off rotation. [valid 2025-06-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-05]
    earlier: As of the 2025-04-16 rotation day, Lena carries the Team Boreal on-call phone, having received the pager from Marcus. [valid 2025-04-16 to 2025-06-05; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-16]
    earlier: Marcus carries the Team Boreal on-call phone from the 2025-02-27 rotation swap until the next rotation. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-16; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- On 2026-06-18, the Ember team on-call swapped and Diego carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-06-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-18]
- As of 2026-03-10, Tomasz Nowak is off the Team Dune on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10]
- On 2026-05-18, Oskar picked up the Ember team on-call shift from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
